answer: Forget passwords and captchas; ask for a life lived in public. Patent inventor record with patent office attestation demands exactly that: a patent naming the applicant as inventor, filed years before this epoch. The orchard of the scheme is the witness list - every entry names a third party who can be asked, and none works for the applicant. Faking one account means staging a whole biography, and the river in the middle is the rehearsal: every date must match every other record. The whisper that seals it is the mismatch test, cheap to run and impossible to pass with a printed past.
